name: Argentina

fees.name: Tourist visa (consular)
fees.notes: Consular fee is USD 150 or EUR 150 depending on the consular office; payable in local currency of the post. Some embassy schedules (e.g. Embassy in Vietnam) still publish lower legacy amounts, so confirm at the specific consulate.

fees.name: AVE - Autorizacion de Viaje Electronica (electronic travel authorization)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue; 90-day stay, multiple entry, one extension possible
fees.applies: eligible visa-required nationalities (90+ countries) holding a valid US visa (B2, J, B1, O, P, E, H-1B) or from US visa-exempt jurisdictions with ESTA/recent US entry; tourism only
fees.notes: Fee stated as USD 400 on the official Embassy of Argentina in Singapore page; applied for via migraciones.gob.ar/ave. Processing up to 20 business days. Chinese citizens with a valid US visa/green card and Indian/Dominican nationals with equivalent US visas are exempt from needing the AVE for tourism.

fees.name: Business visa (consular, transitory)
fees.notes: Per Embassy of Argentina in Vietnam transitory-visa schedule: business USD 100; market survey / trade fair USD 50; technical/professional USD 100 (USD 50 for religious activity). Amounts may vary by consular post.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No visa needed if departing within 12 hours of arrival with onward ticket and declared as a transit traveller (must remain in the airport/station). Fee per Embassy in Vietnam schedule; may vary by post.

vfs.note: Argentina does not outsource visa applications to VFS Global, TLScontact or BLS; applications are lodged directly with Argentine consulates or via the online AVE portal (migraciones.gob.ar/ave).

free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~90 countries (US, EU, UK, Canada, most of Latin America, etc.) enter visa-free for up to 90 days. The former 'reciprocity fee' for US, Canadian and Australian citizens has been abolished. No fee for visa-exempt travellers.
